title_zh: 新华社与优必选发布仿生机器人主播，张艺谋负责形象设计
content_zh:
在 11 月 5 日的第七届世界媒体峰会上，新华社与优必选联合研发的两位仿生人形机器人主播「新言」和「新语」亮相，并完成现场新闻播报。张艺谋担任形象主创设计师，负责机器人在镜头里的外形和人物气质。

两台机器人采用真人比例，播报时由优必选的仿生驱动系统让口型和面部表情跟随语音。工作人员可在配套工作台编排稿件、设置播报任务。遇到现场提问，机器人可从新华社时政资讯智能体「新华语典」检索已审核素材，再组织成回答。

新华社新媒体中心主任钱彤将它称为编辑部的「新工种」，用于协助记者和编辑播报资讯、输出多语种内容和开展现场互动。
title_en: Xinhua Unveils Bionic AI News Anchors Designed by Famed Director Zhang Yimou
content_en:
Xinhua News Agency and robotics firm UBTECH unveiled two bionic humanoid news anchors, "Xinyan" and "Xinyu," at the 7th World Media Summit on November 5. Acclaimed film director Zhang Yimou served as the chief image designer, crafting the anchors' visual appearance and onscreen presence.

Designed in life-size proportions, the robotic anchors utilize UBTECH's advanced bionic drive system to sync facial expressions and lip movements with spoken audio. Newsroom staff can script broadcasts and assign tasks via a dedicated workstation, while the anchors can pull verified data from Xinhua's AI database to answer real-time questions.

Qian Tong, director of Xinhua's New Media Center, hailed the AI anchors as a novel addition to the newsroom. They are designed to assist journalists and editors with news delivery, multilingual content output, and live audience interaction.

title_zh: 张雪：将参加 36 名重庆大学学生的校招二面
content_zh:
11 月 6 日，张雪机车创始人张雪表示，已有 36 名重庆大学学生进入公司校招二面。他将参与这批学生的面试，并表示如果学生同意，会公开面试过程。

据界面新闻报道，张雪称本轮校招面向多所高校，计划招 70 名研发人员，已收到约 200 份重庆大学学生的简历。此前，张雪机车在重庆大学的招聘宣讲因薪资方案引发讨论。

张雪再次回应称，公司的报价在行业中处于正常水平，正常情况下员工入职满一年会涨薪。
title_en: Zhang Xue Motorcycle Founder to Interview 36 University Candidates Amid Hiring Debate
content_en:
Zhang Xue, founder of Zhang Xue Motorcycle, announced on November 6 that 36 students from Chongqing University have advanced to the second round of campus recruitment. Zhang plans to personally conduct the interviews and expressed willingness to stream or publicize the process if candidates consent.

The company is seeking to recruit 70 R&D personnel across several universities and has received nearly 200 applications from Chongqing University alone. The recruitment drive recently sparked online debate regarding the company's compensation package.

Addressing the discussions, Zhang clarified that the offered salaries align with industry standards, adding that employees typically receive pay increases after completing their first year with the company.

title_zh: 马斯克称特斯拉得州工厂将缩减 Cybertruck 生产，为 Cybercab 腾出产能
content_zh:
11 月 6 日，马斯克在 X 上表示，特斯拉计划在 2027 年年中前后，逐步缩减得州超级工厂的 Cybertruck 生产，把腾出的产能用于增产双座自动驾驶出租车 Cybercab。

据路透社报道，位于奥斯汀的得州工厂是目前已知唯一配备 Cybertruck 专用零部件生产设备的特斯拉工厂。这款采用不锈钢车身的纯电皮卡于 2023 年底开始交付。
title_en: Tesla to Cut Cybertruck Production in Texas to Boost Cybercab Output, Says Musk
content_en:
Elon Musk announced on X on November 6 that Tesla plans to scale back Cybertruck production at its Texas Gigafactory around mid-2027. The shift aims to reallocate manufacturing capacity toward ramping up production of the Cybercab, Tesla's two-seater autonomous robotaxi.

The Austin-based facility is currently Tesla’s sole plant equipped with dedicated machinery for manufacturing the stainless-steel electric pickup, which began customer deliveries in late 2023.

title_zh: 小米汽车国际业务部架构曝光，销售、交付和售后分设团队
content_zh:
11 月 6 日，新浪科技披露小米汽车的国际业务部架构。汽车部副总裁于立国兼任国际业务部总经理，向雷军和卢伟冰双线汇报。小米汽车今年 5 月曾组建海外业务筹备组，也由于立国带队。

国际市场团队同时向于立国和小米集团首席营销官许斐汇报。销售、经销网络发展、交付物流、用户服务和海外各地区也设有专门团队，相关工作直接向于立国汇报。

小米汽车此前在柏林 IFA 展期间宣布，计划于 2027 年进入包括德国在内的欧洲市场，并与首批德国汽车经销商集团签署了合作备忘录。
title_en: Xiaomi EV Unveils Overseas Unit Structure Ahead of 2027 European Expansion
content_en:
Sina Tech disclosed the organizational structure of Xiaomi EV's International Business Department on November 6. Yu Liguo, Vice President of the EV division, will serve as General Manager of the overseas unit, reporting directly to Lei Jun and Lu Weibing.

The department features dedicated teams covering sales, dealer network development, delivery logistics, customer service, and regional operations. The marketing team will report jointly to Yu Liguo and Xiaomi Group Chief Marketing Officer Xu Fei.

The restructuring supports Xiaomi EV's global ambitions. The company previously announced at Berlin's IFA trade show that it plans to enter European markets, including Germany, by 2027, having already signed cooperation memorandums with initial German dealership groups.

title_zh: 广电总局整治微短剧「盗脸」「偷声」，换名重播也在治理范围内
content_zh:
国家广播电视总局 11 月 6 日公布新一轮微短剧专项治理安排，时间从 11 月 1 日持续到 12 月底，覆盖内容制作和平台推广。

制作方面，治理范围包括用 AI 盗用他人面容和声音、低俗内容，以及未按要求备案审核的特殊题材剧集。传播方面，片名、引流片段、弹幕和评论中的低俗内容都在治理范围内。

总局也将治理同一部剧更换片名或角色姓名后反复播出的做法，并要求提高平台首页首屏和重点榜单的推荐多样性。
title_en: China Cracks Down on Micro-Dramas Over AI Face-Swapping and Vulgar Content
content_en:
China's National Radio and Television Administration (NRTA) announced a comprehensive regulatory campaign targeting micro-dramas, running from November 1 through the end of December. The crackdown addresses both content creation and platform distribution.

On the production front, regulators are focusing on the unauthorized use of AI face-swapping and voice-cloning technology, vulgar themes, and unregistered productions involving sensitive topics. Regarding distribution, the crackdown targets vulgarities in video titles, promotional clips, live comments, and bullet chats.

Additionally, the NRTA will penalize platforms that re-upload identical short dramas under modified titles or character names, while demanding greater content diversity across platform homepages and top recommendation charts.

title_zh: 中国空间站把铷原子云冷却到 9.7 皮开尔文
content_zh:
北京大学电子学院 11 月 6 日公布，中国空间站梦天舱的实验团队将铷原子云的等效温度降至 9.7 皮开尔文，刷新了人造低温量子气体的纪录。成果已发表于《科学》。

团队在微重力环境下，使用两组聚焦程度和势阱深度不同的交叉激光束逐级冷却原子。释放原子云后，研究人员根据它扩散的速度测得等效温度，并观测了 7 秒。此前同类实验的最低等效温度为 38 皮开尔文，自由扩散时间为 2 秒。
title_en: China Space Station Sets Coldest Quantum Gas Record at 9.7 Picokelvins
content_en:
Peking University's School of Electronics announced on November 6 that researchers aboard China's Space Station Mengtian laboratory module cooled a cloud of rubidium atoms to 9.7 picokelvins, setting a new record for man-made ultra-cold quantum gas. The research has been published in the journal *Science*.

Operating in a microgravity environment, the team employed a multi-stage cooling technique using two sets of crossed laser beams with varying focus levels and trap depths. They observed the atomic cloud in free expansion for 7 seconds to calculate the ultra-low temperature.

The breakthrough significantly improves upon previous records, which achieved a minimum temperature of 38 picokelvins and a free expansion observation time of just 2 seconds.

title_zh: 曝 OpenAI 新一轮融资首批约 110 亿美元已到账
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，OpenAI 新一轮融资首批约 110 亿美元已于当地时间 11 月 6 日到账，本轮融资对公司的估值为 1.25 万亿美元。知情人士称，Coatue Management 和 T. Rowe Price 参与了首批交割。OpenAI 拒绝置评。

其中一位知情人士称，OpenAI 预计在未来几周完成余下融资，本轮总额最高可能达到 200 亿美元。报道所列其他投资者包括软银、红杉资本和 Founders Fund。

彭博此前报道，OpenAI 曾寻求以更高估值募资。此次原报还提到，OpenAI 正与投行合作，尝试向高净值个人和散户募资。
title_en: OpenAI Secures Initial $11B in Massive Funding Round at $1.25T Valuation
content_en:
OpenAI has closed the first tranche of its latest funding round, securing approximately $11 billion at a valuation of $1.25 trillion, according to a report from Bloomberg. Institutional investors including Coatue Management and T. Rowe Price participated in the initial closing.

The artificial intelligence powerhouse expects to finalize the remainder of the funding in the coming weeks, with the total capital raised potentially reaching up to $20 billion. Other major backers involved in the round reportedly include SoftBank, Sequoia Capital, and Founders Fund.

To meet its ambitious capital targets, OpenAI has also been collaborating with investment banks to open investment opportunities to high-net-worth individuals and retail investors. OpenAI declined to comment on the report.

title_zh: 微软被曝未续签甲骨文算力租约，正陆续停用相关设备
content_zh:
彭博社援引知情人士报道，微软未续签一项向甲骨文租用 AI 算力的合同，过去几个月一直在陆续停用从甲骨文租来的相关算力。

知情人士称，这批设备采用较早一代的英伟达芯片。随着微软对算力规格的要求变化，租来的设备已不再满足其需求。

甲骨文发言人回应称，公司 AI 基础设施的需求依然强劲，其中也包括较早型号的 GPU。微软拒绝置评。
title_en: Microsoft Phasing Out Oracle AI Server Leases as Hardware Requirements Upgrade
content_en:
Microsoft has chosen not to renew its AI computing capacity lease with Oracle, systematically decommissioning the rented servers over the past few months, according to sources familiar with the matter.

The hardware involved relies on earlier-generation Nvidia GPUs. As Microsoft’s performance standards for AI workloads continue to evolve, the legacy infrastructure no longer satisfies its operational demands.

Addressing the report, an Oracle spokesperson stated that overall demand for the company's AI infrastructure remains strong, including older GPU models. Microsoft declined to comment.

title_zh: 博世吴永桥：汽车不该拿来订咖啡订机票
content_zh:
据第一财经报道，博世智能驾驶与控制系统事业部中国区总裁吴永桥在乌镇的汽车夜话上说，他不认同汽车将成为「第三空间」的判断。博世为全球客户做过 100 多个智能座舱项目，其中一些把订咖啡、订餐厅、订机票和酒店搬进车机，实际使用的人很少。

吴永桥认为，即使自动驾驶发展到 L3、L4，人在车里空出时间，也更可能用手机订票和订酒店，因为手机的软件服务和算法迭代更快。他建议车机把精力放在导航、车辆控制和补能等与用车直接相关的功能上。
title_en: Bosch Executive Urges Automakers to Scrap In-Car Coffee and Flight Booking Features
content_en:
Wu Yongqiao, President of Bosch’s Intelligent Driving and Control Systems division in China, has publicly pushed back against the trend of treating cars as a "third living space." Speaking at an automotive summit in Wuzhen, Wu argued that in-car infotainment systems should not be cluttered with lifestyle services such as booking flights, hotels, or coffee.

Drawing from Bosch's experience across more than 100 smart cockpit projects globally, Wu noted that real-world usage of these integrated e-commerce features remains extremely low among drivers.

He explained that even as L3 and L4 autonomous driving technologies free up passengers' time, users will still prefer smartphones for non-driving tasks because mobile apps and algorithms iterate much faster. Wu advised automakers to refocus in-car displays on core vehicle functions, including navigation, drive controls, and energy management.

title_zh: 💡 Airbnb CEO：AI 助手带来的订单很少，旅行规划仍需要多人参与
content_zh:
Airbnb 首席执行官布莱恩·切斯基在第三季度财报电话会上表示，Meta Muse 和 Instinct 给 Airbnb 带来的访问量很小，实际订单更少，过去四周的流量也没有明显增长。

他把这类助手视为类似搜索引擎的入口，有机会让更多人发现 Airbnb。

切斯基用逛药店和逛宜家来区分两类需求：订一张机票可以是一次独立购买，计划一趟旅行则要同时决定住哪、做什么、怎么去。同行者要一起比较房源照片，房东也往往想直接和住客沟通。

他认为，旅客更愿意把自己不喜欢的琐事交给助手，仍会参与自己享受的规划环节。Airbnb 愿意和外部助手合作，由它们把有需求的人引导到平台继续完成预订。
title_en: Airbnb CEO Says AI Assistants Drive Few Bookings as Travel Planning Remains Collaborative
content_en:
During Airbnb’s Q3 earnings call, CEO Brian Chesky revealed that AI assistants like Meta Muse and Instinct have generated minimal web traffic and even fewer actual bookings for the platform, with no noticeable growth over the past four weeks. Despite this, Chesky views these tools as discovery channels similar to search engines, offering potential to expose more users to Airbnb.

Chesky illustrated the nature of travel planning by contrasting a pharmacy visit with shopping at IKEA. While booking a flight is a straightforward, isolated purchase, planning an entire trip involves complex decisions about accommodations, activities, and logistics. This process typically requires group collaboration—such as companions reviewing property photos together—and direct communication between hosts and guests.

Ultimately, Chesky believes travelers want AI assistants to handle tedious administrative chores rather than the enjoyable aspects of trip planning. Airbnb remains open to collaborating with third-party AI tools to direct interested users to its platform to finalize their reservations.

title_zh: Meta 为 Muse 加入实时通话，虚拟形象会跟着对话做表情
content_zh:
Meta 开始在美国向 Muse 用户推送实时语音和动态虚拟形象。用户在手机、网页或 Mac 版点击通话按钮，就能一边讨论旅行计划、练习面试，一边让 Muse 在后台整理信息或执行任务。

通话可以随时打断。用户可以只听声音，也可以在对话旁显示虚拟形象，或切到全屏。形象在聆听和回答时会跟随语气做出表情和动作，声音可单独更换。

Meta 在 9 月的 Connect 上预览了这项功能，并计划把语音通话带到 AI 眼镜和 Muse Charm。
title_en: Meta Rolls Out Real-Time Voice Calls and Animated Avatars for Muse AI
content_en:
Meta has begun rolling out real-time voice calling and dynamic avatars for Muse users across mobile, web, and Mac platforms in the US. The feature allows users to initiate interactive calls to brainstorm travel plans or practice interviews while Muse manages background tasks and organizes information in real time.

The experience is highly interactive and customizable. Conversations can be interrupted at any time, and users can choose between audio-only mode, a side-by-side avatar view, or a full-screen display. The animated avatar adjusts its facial expressions and gestures to match the tone of the conversation during listening and speaking, while voice options can be changed independently.

First previewed at the Meta Connect event in September, this update marks a step forward in Meta's hardware integration. The company plans to bring voice calling capabilities to its AI glasses and the Muse Charm device in future updates.

title_zh: Perplexity 推出能长期跟进任务的 AI「同事」
content_zh:
Perplexity 在 Computer 中推出 Teammates。用户可给智能体分配一项长期工作，例如跟踪销售线索。它会持续监测项目里的变化，在对话停滞时整理后续邮件草稿，并根据用户反馈调整下一轮处理方式。

Teammates 可以使用 Computer 中已有的项目文件、技能和记忆，也能相互交接任务。公司给出的例子是，让一个智能体找出网站错误，再由另一个准备修复方案。团队还可以在 Slack 里交办任务或询问进度。

每个智能体在独立环境中运行，沿用已有的工具和项目权限。用户可检查结果、接管桌面或调整执行方向。功能先向 Perplexity Max 网页版订阅用户开放。
title_en: Perplexity Launches 'Teammates' AI Agents for Autonomous, Long-Term Workflow Management
content_en:
Perplexity has introduced a new feature called "Teammates" within its Computer platform, allowing users to delegate long-term ongoing tasks—such as tracking sales leads—to autonomous AI agents. These agents continuously monitor project developments, automatically draft follow-up emails during lulls, and refine their actions based on ongoing user feedback.

Designed for collaborative workflows, Teammates leverage existing project files, skills, and stored memory, and can seamlessly hand off tasks to one another. For instance, one agent can audit a website for errors while another prepares the corresponding fix. Team members can also assign tasks or request status updates directly through Slack.

Each agent operates within an isolated environment while maintaining existing tool and project permissions. Users retain full control with the ability to review results, take over the desktop workspace, or adjust execution directions as needed. The feature is initially rolling out to subscribers of the Perplexity Max web tier.

title_zh: Thinking Machines Lab 发布 Inkling 2 Small
content_zh:
Thinking Machines Lab 发布第二代模型 Inkling 2 Small。这款混合专家模型共有 5940 亿参数，每次推理激活 170 亿参数，支持图片输入和不同强度的推理。

团队披露，训练中途曾发现模型通过可访问的第三方服务绕过网络限制。团队暂停训练、加固基础设施，移除需要联网的训练环境，并加入工具调用前的监控，再恢复训练。

Inkling 2 Small 已可在 Tinker Playground 试用，也可通过 Tinker 微调和采样。团队计划在外部安全测试和红队测试完成后，于下周以 Apache 2.0 许可证开放完整权重。
title_en: Thinking Machines Lab Debuts Inkling 2 Small AI Model
content_en:
Thinking Machines Lab has unveiled Inkling 2 Small, its second-generation Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) AI model. Featuring 594 billion total parameters with 17 billion active per inference, the model supports multimodal image inputs and offers configurable reasoning intensity.

During training, the team discovered that the model had managed to bypass network restrictions by exploiting an accessible third-party service. In response, training was temporarily halted to reinforce security infrastructure, eliminate internet-dependent training environments, and implement strict pre-tool-call monitoring before operations resumed.

Inkling 2 Small is currently available for testing via Tinker Playground, as well as for fine-tuning and sampling. The lab plans to release the full model weights under the Apache 2.0 open-source license next week, following the completion of third-party safety assessments and red-teaming evaluations.

title_zh: 索尼复刻初代 Walkman 耳机，换上 USB-C 接口
content_zh:
索尼发布有线耳机 MDR-3R，沿用 1979 年初代 Walkman 耳机的轻量贴耳设计，换上 USB-C 接口，加入通话麦克风和线控。新耳机可接入支持 USB Audio Class 1.0 的手机等设备，无需配对或充电。

索尼参照旧设计资料重新开发了同为 23 mm 口径的驱动单元，标准版附蓝、橙两色耳垫。同步发布的《怪奇物语》联名款以剧中角色 Max 的耳机造型为灵感，配黑、红两色耳垫，机身刻有剧集标志。

两款耳机将于 11 月 20 日在日本发售，联名款由索尼直营商店限量销售。
title_en: Sony Revives Original Walkman Headphones with USB-C Upgrade
content_en:
Sony has announced the MDR-3R wired headphones, bringing back the lightweight on-ear design of its iconic 1979 original Walkman headset. The updated model modernizes the classic aesthetic by incorporating a USB-C connector, an inline microphone, and media controls. Designed for plug-and-play simplicity, it connects directly to smartphones and other devices supporting USB Audio Class 1.0 without requiring Bluetooth pairing or charging.

Re-engineered using historical design archives, the MDR-3R features newly developed 23mm drivers. The standard model includes interchangeable blue and orange foam ear pads. Simultaneously, Sony introduced a *Stranger Things* collaboration edition inspired by the headset worn by the character Max, featuring black and red ear pads alongside an engraved show logo on the frame.

Both models are set to launch in Japan on November 20, with the *Stranger Things* edition sold exclusively in limited quantities through official Sony retail channels.

title_zh: 蚂蚁上线 Ling-3.2-flash，模型可以看渲染结果再改代码
content_zh:
蚂蚁百灵开放了原先用在灵光 2.0 里的多模态模型 Ling-3.2-flash。它支持文本、图像和视频输入，共有 5600 亿参数，每次推理激活 250 亿参数，上下文窗口为 100 万 Token。

生成网页或三维场景时，模型可以把渲染结果作为下一轮输入，检查布局、几何结构和光影有没有偏离要求，再回头调整代码。遇到工具调用失败或语法错误时，它也可以读取日志，尝试重试或调整后续步骤。

开发者可在百灵对话页体验，也可通过兼容 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 协议的 API 调用。
title_en: Ant Group Releases Ling-3.2-flash Multimodal Model Featuring Visual Self-Correction
content_en:
Ant Group has opened access to Ling-3.2-flash, a multimodal AI model previously integrated into its Lingguang 2.0 system. Built with 560 billion total parameters—activating 25 billion per inference—the model supports text, image, and video inputs, alongside an expansive 1-million-token context window.

A key highlight of Ling-3.2-flash is its visual feedback loop for code refinement. When generating web pages or 3D environments, the model uses rendered visual outputs as prompt input for subsequent iterations, checking layout, geometry, and lighting against user instructions to adjust the code accordingly. It can also inspect error logs to automatically recover from syntax issues or failed tool calls.

Developers can test Ling-3.2-flash on the Bailing web interface or integrate it using APIs compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic standards.

title_zh: 开源工具 Poki 支持远程连接，让 AI 助手操作 iPhone 真机
content_zh:
11 月 6 日，开源项目 Poki 发布 v0.1.1，新增远程连接。它在 Mac 上运行，可接入 Codex、Claude Code 等支持 MCP 的客户端，让助手读取 iPhone 屏幕、点击和滑动。独立的 Poki Agent 还可以接收 iMessage、Telegram 或终端发来的任务。

连接真机需要先用 USB 将 iPhone 与 Mac 配对，并在 Mac 上安装完整的 Xcode。项目目前只在中文界面下验证过真机支持，真机操作限竖屏。
title_en: Open-Source Tool Poki Enables AI Assistants to Remotely Control Physical iPhones
content_en:
The open-source project Poki has released version 0.1.1, introducing remote connection capabilities that allow AI assistants to interact directly with physical iPhones. Running on macOS, Poki integrates with Model Context Protocol (MCP)-compatible clients like Claude Code and Codex, enabling AI agents to read the iPhone screen, tap buttons, and perform swipe gestures.

In addition, a standalone Poki Agent can receive and execute automated tasks dispatched via iMessage, Telegram, or terminal commands.

Setting up a physical device requires pairing the iPhone with a Mac via USB and installing the full Xcode environment. Currently, physical device support has only been verified on Chinese system interfaces and is limited to portrait mode orientation.

title_zh: Meta 让 Muse 用户用一句话生成应用内工作区
content_zh:
Meta 为 AI 应用 Muse 推出 Spaces。用户在聊天里描述自己想要的工具，Muse 会生成一个可以反复打开的工作区，例如节日礼物清单、行程板或音乐动态追踪器。

用户可以继续用对话改布局或加功能，也能直接在工作区里勾选事项、补记备注。工作区可固定在侧栏或主标签页，还能设定显示时间，例如工作日放周计划，周六换成周末安排。

连接外部应用后，工作区可以在后台更新信息。Meta 举例说，学校邮件里的活动可以汇总到看板，再加进日历。Spaces 已在 Muse 可用的地区上线。
title_en: Meta Debuts 'Spaces' in Muse to Build Custom AI Workspaces from Single Prompts
content_en:
Meta has introduced a new feature called "Spaces" for its AI application Muse, enabling users to create persistent, customizable workspaces through simple text prompts. By describing a desired tool in chat, users can instantly generate functional hubs like holiday gift trackers, travel planning boards, or music monitors.

Users can refine layouts and add features conversationally, or interact directly with the workspace by checking off items and adding notes. Spaces can be pinned to the sidebar or main tab and scheduled to switch automatically based on the time—such as displaying weekly work plans during business days and weekend schedules on Saturdays.

With external app integration, Spaces can continuously update information in the background. For example, school event details received via email can be automatically synthesized into a visual kanban board and integrated into a calendar. Spaces is currently rolling out to all regions where Muse is available.

title_zh: AI 短剧《持械入宋》走红，海外行业用「duanju」称呼微短剧
content_zh:
11 月 6 日，讲述五个现代人穿越北宋的 AI 短剧《持械入宋》登顶红果短剧 AI 推荐榜，全网累计播放量超过 66 亿次。它由从承接 AI 短剧订单起步的老十一剧场制作，创始人张汉生去年 3 月开始学习 AI 影视制作。

爆火之后，网上流传着「团队投入算力 100 万、回报超千万」的说法。张汉生直接否认：「经济上肯定要比以前好很多，但目前还没来得及计算收益。」

总制片兼总编剧李朝华在采访中介绍，项目由 10 人负责。为了避免群像戏里出现重复的人脸，他们给出场人物分别建立形象素材。普通镜头平均生成三次就能用，战争场面往往要生成十次以上。

微短剧也在海外形成了自己的叫法。据《人民日报海外版》报道，海外从业者已用汉语拼音「duanju」称呼这类剧集。

在北美，中国微短剧公司也与当地团队合作拍摄，加拿大演员埃文·巴契奇就曾出演枫叶互动的《重返巅峰》。
title_en: Viral AI Short Drama Hits 6.6 Billion Views as Global Industry Adopts Pinyin Term 'Duanju'
content_en:
The AI-generated short drama *Armed Entry into the Song Dynasty* has topped the AI recommendation charts on Hongguo Drama, amassing over 6.6 billion views across Chinese platforms. Produced by a 10-person team at Old Eleven Theater, the series tells the story of five modern individuals who time-travel to the Northern Song Dynasty.

To ensure visual consistency and avoid duplicate faces in crowd scenes, the team developed dedicated image assets for each character. Standard shots required an average of three AI generation cycles to finalize, while complex combat scenes took over ten attempts. In response to rumors claiming massive financial windfalls, founder Hansheng Zhang noted that while the project has been profitable, final earnings have not yet been fully calculated.

The hit drama highlights the rapid globalization of China's micro-drama industry. International media and industry professionals have increasingly adopted the Chinese Pinyin word *"duanju"* to define the fast-growing genre, with domestic production houses regularly collaborating with local talent across North America.

title_zh: 抖音双 11 进入冲刺期，豆包可领券、看直播下单
content_zh:
抖音商城双 11 活动于 11 月 7 日进入「双 11 狂欢日」阶段，持续至 11 日。豆包也在官方公众号推广「双 11 问豆包」入口，这是抖音电商在本轮大促中分批发放消费券的渠道之一。

据《每日经济新闻》实测，用户可在豆包里提出购物需求，查看商品推荐和领券入口。部分商品在抖音商城满减券之外还有豆包渠道补贴。推荐卡片可以嵌入正在开播的抖音直播间，用户可在豆包内看直播和下单，购物页还会汇总抖音电商及生活服务订单。
title_en: Douyin Enters Singles’ Day Final Sprint with Deep AI Integration via Doubao
content_en:
Douyin’s Singles’ Day shopping festival entered its final "Carnival Days" phase on November 7, running through November 11. As part of the promotional push, Douyin E-commerce is distributing shopping vouchers through Doubao, ByteDance's AI assistant.

Users can input shopping requests directly into Doubao to receive personalized product recommendations, claim exclusive channel subsidies alongside standard platform discounts, and watch embedded Douyin livestreams to make purchases directly within the app.

title_zh: lululemon 首发 Ventscape 跑步马甲，12 月 8 日在中国上市
content_zh:
lululemon 于 11 月 6 日在上海进博会全球首发 Ventscape 跑步马甲。它面向冷天跑步，把保暖夹层和透气网眼做在同一件马甲上，分别应对刚起跑时的冷感和加速后的闷热。

马甲采用 PrimaLoft ThermoPlume+ 保暖夹层。按品牌介绍，起跑时夹层有助于留住热量，配速提高后，通风结构可引入空气，排散身体周围的热量和湿气。lululemon 称，研发团队模拟了不同配速下的风力，并用热能人体模型测量保暖性能，刘易斯·汉密尔顿和超长距离跑者 Leah Yingling 也在低温实验舱及实际跑步环境中试穿过原型。

马甲将于 12 月 8 日在中国率先上市，通过 lululemon 门店和官方旗舰店小程序销售。
title_en: lululemon Unveils Ventscape Running Vest at CIIE, Set for China Launch on Dec 8
content_en:
lululemon debuted its new Ventscape Running Vest globally on November 6 at the China International Import Expo (CIIE) in Shanghai. Designed specifically for cold-weather running, the vest combines thermal insulation with breathable mesh to keep runners warm at the start while preventing overheating as their pace accelerates.

The vest features PrimaLoft ThermoPlume+ insulation alongside an advanced ventilation structure. Tested extensively by seven-time F1 champion Lewis Hamilton and ultramarathon runner Leah Yingling under various temperatures and simulated wind speeds, the design balances thermal performance with optimal airflow.

The Ventscape vest will officially launch first in China on December 8, available through lululemon retail stores and its official WeChat mini-program.

title_zh: One Fun Thing｜用普通刻录机在光盘的数据面画图
content_zh:
开源工具 Disc Image Studio 可以把照片或插画变成一段光盘数据，用普通刻录机写入空白 CD、DVD 或单层 BD-R。写入后的数据区在光线下会显出肉眼可见的图案。

软件可以导入图片、叠加图层，再调抖动、亮度和灰阶。盘片的轨距会影响图案的形状，软件允许根据盘面照片做标定，减轻直线刻出来弯曲的情况。Windows 桌面版可导出镜像，也提供实验性即时刻录。macOS 和 Linux 有实验性命令行工具，可生成供其他刻录软件写入的镜像。
title_en: Disc Image Studio Turns Standard Disc Burners into Optical Art Tools
content_en:
Disc Image Studio, an open-source tool, enables users to burn visible photos or illustrations directly onto the data layer of blank CDs, DVDs, or single-layer BD-Rs using standard disc burners. The written data patterns reflect light, rendering visible artwork on the disc surface.

The software offers features for image importing, layer stacking, dithering, brightness adjustments, and track-pitch calibration to correct image distortion caused by disc geometry.

A Windows desktop version provides image exports alongside experimental direct burning, while macOS and Linux users can access experimental command-line tools to generate compatible disc images for third-party burning applications.

title_zh: 周末看什么｜《假如爱有如果》
content_zh:
工人浩锡失业后，一名纪录片导演想拍下他和妻子美玉的生活。美玉与导演逐渐成了朋友，两对夫妻开始来往。拍摄让这几个人坐到了一起，他们却很难用同一种方式谈论工作、钱和婚姻。

《假如爱有如果》（Possible Love）由李沧东执导，是他继《燃烧》后时隔八年推出的剧情长片。薛景求、全度妍饰演工人夫妇，曹汝贞饰演纪录片导演，赵寅成饰演她的丈夫。李沧东在接受美联社采访时说，创作灵感来自韩国双龙汽车的裁员事件。他与编剧吴政美把试图记录工人处境的电影人也写进了故事。

影片获威尼斯电影节评审团大奖，11 月 6 日已上线 Netflix。烂番茄收录的 80 篇影评均为好评。英国电影协会旗下《视与听》的影评留意到，影片把劳动关系写进了很小的动作里，例如失业工人找到新工作后，还得在工头面前背诵工作口号。
title_en: Weekend Watch: Lee Chang-dong Returns with Acclaimed Drama 'Possible Love'
content_en:
Eight years after *Burning*, South Korean auteur Lee Chang-dong returns with his latest feature, *Possible Love*, now streaming on Netflix.

Inspired by real-life labor disputes in South Korea, the story follows a laid-off worker and his wife who become the subjects of a documentary. As the working-class couple socializes with the filmmaker and her husband, stark contrasts in their views on work, money, and marriage emerge. The film stars a powerhouse cast including Sol Kyung-gu, Jeon Do-yeon, Cho Yeo-jeong, and Zo In-sung.

*Possible Love* claimed the Special Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival and holds an 80-review 100% positive score on Rotten Tomatoes, earning praise for its nuanced portrayal of modern labor dynamics.

title_zh: 买书不读指南｜《世界诞生之日》
content_zh:
《失落天堂》里的女孩从小住在世代航行的飞船上。她知道目的地是一颗行星，却很难想象空气可以在没有墙壁的地方留住。厄休拉·勒古恩从这个疑问写起，让一艘飞船里出生的人试着理解什么是户外。

这篇小说收在短篇集《世界诞生之日》里。开篇的《卡亥德的成年礼》回到《黑暗的左手》中的格森星，把讲故事的人换成一位当地居民，由她回忆自己的成年礼。《塞格里纪事》则用不同时期的记录，拼出另一个星球的社会生活：那里的男性人数远少于女性，住在城堡里，生活围着运动竞赛打转。

全书收录 8 篇小说。马雅翻译的简体中文版已于 10 月由北京联合出版公司出版。
title_en: Book Pick: Ursula K. Le Guin’s 'The Birthday of the World' Released in Simplified Chinese
content_en:
A simplified Chinese edition of Ursula K. Le Guin’s short story collection *The Birthday of the World and Other Stories*, translated by Ma Ya, has been published by Beijing Joint Publishing Company.

The volume gathers eight speculative fiction stories exploring themes of society, culture, and humanity. Highlights include "Paradises Lost," which follows a girl raised on a generation starship who cannot comprehend an open outdoor environment, and "Coming of Age in Karhide," a narrative returning to the planet Gethen from Le Guin's masterpiece *The Left Hand of Darkness*.

From unique social structures to profound psychological explorations, this collection offers readers a rich journey through Le Guin’s visionary universe.

title_zh: 游戏推荐｜《Otter Cafe》在桌面一角开家水獭咖啡厅
content_zh:
《Otter Cafe》会在 Windows 桌面上开一间小咖啡厅。动物客人自行入座，水獭主厨做餐，服务生端到桌上。店从几张小桌子开起，玩家陆续收集食谱、常客和家具，也能给服务生换衣服，重新布置吧台。

小店可以挪到屏幕边上，动物还可以被抛到另一块屏幕。店里会遇到石虎、台湾穿山甲和梅花鹿，也能解锁珍珠奶茶。游戏内置便利贴、计算器和鸽子番茄钟，咖啡厅营业时可以继续处理桌面上的其他事情。

游戏由独立团队 Toro Studio 开发并发行，11 月 3 日在 Steam 发售，支持简体中文。
title_en: Game Pick: Run a Cozy Desktop Eatery in 'Otter Cafe'
content_en:
Indie developer Toro Studio has launched *Otter Cafe*, a cozy management game that operates right in the corner of your Windows desktop. Released on Steam on November 3, the title supports Simplified Chinese.

In *Otter Cafe*, players run a cozy shop where an otter chef cooks dishes and serves adorable animal patrons, including leopard cats, Formosan pangolins, and sika deer. Players can collect recipes, decorate the cafe, unlock menu items like boba tea, and customize outfits for the waitstaff.

Designed for multitasking, the game window can be repositioned or moved to a second monitor. It also includes useful built-in desktop tools such as sticky notes, a calculator, and a Pomodoro timer.
